seo.title: Ishuri rya Siporo — Isôoko Community Development
seo.description: Imyitozo ya siporo ya buri munsi mu cyubahiro n'ibikorwa bya siporo byo mu gihe cyangwa mu buzima bwa buri munsi hamwe n'abahugurwa abaranga. Siporo y'urugo.

hero.title: Siporo Y'urugo
hero.subtitle: Ishuri rya siporo ry'ubuntu n'ibikorwa bya siporo byo mu gihe cyangwa byubahirijwe n'abahugurwa abaranga — aho umenye, igihe ushaka

live.title: Ibikorwa byo Mu Gihe
live.subtitle: Jya mu bikorwa byacu byo mu gihe — ubusabane bw'urubuga
live.noSessions: Nta bikorwa byo mu gihe biri. Subira vuba!

reminder.title: Bona urwibutso
reminder.name: Amazina yawe
reminder.subscribed: Uri ku rutonde — tuzakwandikira imeyili mbere y'uko ibikorwa bitangira!
reminder.error: Ntushobora kwiyandikisha vuba aha. Gerageza nanone.

step1.title: Hitamo Ikorwa
step1.desc: Reba ibikorwa byacu byose mu buryo bwa videwo maze uhitemo iryo ryihariye urwego rwawe.

step2.title: Kurikirana
step2.desc: Reba umwishyitsi maze ukurikire umwitozo ku buryo bwa mbere bwo mu rugo.

step3.title: Kurikirana Ibyagezweho
step3.desc: Komeza gukora siporo maze utekereze hejuru y'ubuviri bwawe n'ubuzima bwawe.
